# t/fuguweb/rotate.t drives the rotation against signify(1), and it
# skips the whole file without that command. The tool environment
# installs before every other one, and deps-test depends on deps, so
# the command is there when the test runs. The key verbs of fuguweb
# need it too, per WEB-ROTATE-17. The runtime dist entry takes a
# recorded digest of deps/SHA256.txt, so `fugubench deps` reads
# no published key for it.
tool pkg signify-osx

# The secret gate of make check runs gitleaks, so the tool
# environment installs it before every other environment.
tool bin gitleaks https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v8.30.1/gitleaks_8.30.1_{os}_{arch}.tar.gz gitleaks

runtime dist https://github.com/FuguBSD/Fugu/releases/download/v0.5.0/Fugu.tar.gz
runtime pkg mandoc
runtime pkg lowdown

# gpg(1) makes an OpenPGP key and its binding, per WEB-OPENPGP.
# t/fuguweb/rotate.t and t/fuguweb/keys.t each skip the assertions
# that need it.
runtime pkg gnupg

# openssl(1) signs and verifies the binding of a certificate, per
# WEB-X509. t/fuguweb/rotate.t and t/fuguweb/keys.t each skip the
# assertions that need it.
runtime pkg openssl

test cpan Perl::Critic
test cpan Perl::Tidy
